tracks.name: Drums - 808 Trap Kit
tracks.description: Half-time snare, sparse kicks, and hat rolls give the scaffold its trap grid.

tracks.name: Perc - Sparse Ear Candy
tracks.description: Sparse snaps and percussion leave negative space around the 808 and vocal lane.

tracks.name: Bass - Operator 808
tracks.description: Long low 808 notes follow the minor progression and answer the sparse kick pattern.

tracks.name: Chords - Dark Wavetable Pad
tracks.description: Slow minor pads set the key and mood without crowding the drums.

tracks.name: Hook - Bell Pluck
tracks.description: Sparse bell notes use minor-scale space and leave room for a vocal/topline.
